data.description: Log of a requested statement synchronization. Aggregates the commands created for the requested window.

uid.description: Unique identifier of the request. Use it to check the status.

status.description:
Aggregate status of the request commands:
* `pending` - no commands have started processing
* `processing` - in progress (some commands have finished)
* `done` - all commands were confirmed
* `partial` - all finished, but some failed
* `failed` - all finished and none were confirmed

start_at.description: Start date of the synchronized window.

end_at.description: End date of the synchronized window.

commands_count.description: Number of commands created. Windows crossing more than one month generate one command per month.

commands_summary.description: Number of commands per status. Useful for identifying which month failed when status is `partial`.

commands.description: Request commands. Present only in individual query.

uid.description: Public identifier (UUID) of the Command. Used as a parameter in individual query (`GET /commands/{uid}`).

status.description:
Command status.

`pending`: Command not yet executed. [Initial State]
`confirmed`: Command executed and confirmed.
`failed`: Command execution failed.

resource_type.description: Type of resource to which the Command belongs (ex.: `BankBillet`, `Pix`, `Financial::Account`).

resource_uid.description: Public identifier (UUID) of the resource to which the Command belongs.

financial_provider_slug.description: Slug of the financial provider (bank) responsible for executing the Command.

payload.description: Server response with the result of the operation.

created_at.description: Date of creation of the Command record

updated_at.description: Date of update of the Command record.

confirmation_via.description:
Source of Command confirmation.

`api`: confirmed via response from the bank's API (includes webhooks, Recuperator and sync).
`edi`: confirmed via CNAB return (debit file).
`null`: No recorded source.

kind.description:
Type of Account

`checking`: Checking Account
`savings`: Savings Account
`payment`: Payment Account

agency_digit.description: Agency Digit. Optional: will be calculated automatically using Module 11 when the bank requires it and not provided.

bank_number.description: COMPE Number of the Bank. Required if bank_id is not provided.

custom_data.description: Hash with key and value in JSON format. Optional for internal control.

custom_name.description: Name of the Financial Account for identification within Kobana.

external_id.description: ID in your system. Optional for internal control.

payment_agreement_code.description: Number of the Payment Agreement contracted with the Bank.

tags.description: Tags associated with the import. Optional for internal control.

updated_at.description: Date of last update. iso8601 format

service_accounts.description: Service accounts associated with this financial account.

created_at.description: Date and time of the request.

updated_at.description: Date and time of the last status update.

data.title: v2_statement_sync_request

errors.title: Não foi possível encontrar o registro
errors.detail: Este registro não existe, ou foi deletado.

status.description: HTTP status code of the error. Ex: `400`.

title.description: Brief description of the error. Ex: `Invalid API Token`.

param.description: Name of the parameter that failed validation. Ex: `amount`.

detail.description: Detail of the validation that generated the error. Ex: `cannot be blank`.
